metadata.question: In January 2021, did Nambia experience over 7 inches of rainfall?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use CHIRPS Daily precipitation (UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY) over Namibia polygon for 2021-01-01 to 2021-02-01; fallback to ERA5-Land Daily Aggregated (ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR) if empty.
2. Masking strategy: Not required for precipitation (not an optical dataset). Use unmasked pixel count to validate coverage.
3. Logic: If collection empty → C1. If valid pixels after processing = 0 → C2. If mean is null/NaN or out-of-range (<0 or >4000 mm for one month) → C3. Otherwise compare mean Jan-2021 total precipitation to 177.8 mm (7 inches) to decide A/B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function evalAsync(eobj) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    eobj.evaluate((res, err) => {
      if (err) reject(err);
      else resolve(res);
    });
  });
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const start = '2021-01-01';
    const end = '2021-02-01';
    let admin = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL_SIMPLIFIED_500m/2015/level0')
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Namibia'));
    const adminCount = await evalAsync(admin.size());
    if (!adminCount || adminCount === 0) {
      // Fallback geometry
      admin = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017')
        .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Namibia'));
    }
    const namibia = admin.geometry();

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    let dataset = 'CHIRPS';
    let col = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY')
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filterBounds(namibia)
      .select('precipitation');
    let size = await evalAsync(col.size());
    if (size === 0) {
      // Fallback to ERA5-Land Daily Aggregated
      dataset = 'ERA5_LAND_DAILY_AGGR';
      col = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(namibia)
        .select('total_precipitation_sum');
      size = await evalAsync(col.size());
      if (size === 0) {
        console.log('Images (primary): 0');
        console.log('Images (fallback): 0');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
    }
    console.log(`Dataset: ${dataset}`);
    console.log(`Images (Jan 2021): ${size}`);

    // 3. Processing
    let janSumImg;
    if (dataset === 'CHIRPS') {
      // CHIRPS is mm/day; sum to monthly mm
      janSumImg = col.sum().rename('precip_mm');
    } else {
      // ERA5 total_precipitation_sum is meters/day; sum then convert to mm
      janSumImg = col.sum().multiply(1000).rename('precip_mm');
    }

    // Compute valid pixel count (unmasked pixels in region)
    const countDict = await evalAsync(
      janSumImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: namibia,
        scale: 5000,
        maxPixels: 1e10,
      })
    );
    const pixCount = countDict ? countDict['precip_mm'] : null;
    console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixCount !== null ? pixCount : 0}`);
    if (!pixCount || pixCount === 0) {
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation
    const meanDict = await evalAsync(
      janSumImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: namibia,
        scale: 5000,
        maxPixels: 1e10,
      })
    );
    const meanMM = meanDict ? meanDict['precip_mm'] : null;

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    if (meanMM === null || isNaN(meanMM) || meanMM < 0 || meanMM > 4000) {
      console.log(`Mean Jan 2021 precip (mm): ${meanMM}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    const meanIn = meanMM / 25.4;
    const threshMM = 7 * 25.4; // 177.8 mm
    console.log(`Mean Jan 2021 precip: ${meanMM.toFixed(1)} mm (${meanIn.toFixed(2)} in)`);
    console.log(`Threshold: ${threshMM.toFixed(1)} mm (7.00 in)`);
    const over = meanMM > threshMM;
    console.log(`Over threshold? ${over ? 'Yes' : 'No'}`);
    console.log(over ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${String(err).slice(0, 120)}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
